rules.statement: The Court can order the restoration of a person to possession under Section 328 of the Civil Procedure Code, even if that person was not the judgment-creditor who originally obtained the decree for possession.
rules.supporting_quote: "Section 328 on the other hand as amended, provides for the investigation of a petition by any person other than the judgment-debtor or person in occupation under him, if he is dispossessed of any property in execution of the decree complaining of his dispossession. At the end of the inquiry if the Court is satisfied that the person dispossessed was in possession of the premises on his own account or on account of some person other than the judgment-debtor, the, Court shall direct the petitioner to be put in possession of the property."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 328 of the Civil Procedure Code, as amended.
